inference_prohibitions: Global True does not prove D policy
Missing instance is INDETERMINATE, never policy evidence
Registry string is corroboration/raw data only, never effective-policy proof
TPM flag/metadata/hash is not independent attestation
query_limitations: Get-CimInstance requested properties can return keys/system metadata. Future adapter must project and reject unexpected fields without serializing whole CIM objects. Deadlines here are modeled, not hard native cancellation.

raw_record.API_unavailable: Retain explicit status with null raw/digest; no fallback
raw_record.sha256: Digest of actual raw UTF8 bytes, not authentication

registry_collateral: The single exact PagingFiles value may contain other-drive paths. Owner must explicitly accept its raw local capture. Do not read other registry values or disclose raw value publicly.
runtime: RUNTIME_USAGE_OBSERVED means only returned usage/allocation fields
timestamps: Local OS strings only; not trusted UTC; before/after consistency is not an atomic snapshot

tool_identity.source: Reviewed exact Git source and raw SHA256
